-m "$(cat <<'EOF'
Fix cache corruption under concurrent access

Multiple Bivvy processes sharing the same cache directory could corrupt
entries because store() wrote content and metadata in two separate
non-atomic fs::write() calls, and remove() had a TOCTOU race between
exists() and remove_file().

Three changes fix this:

- Atomic writes: all cache files are now written to a random-suffixed
  temp file then renamed into place, so readers never see half-written
  content.

- Per-entry file locking: store(), update(), remove(), and
  write_content() acquire an exclusive flock(2) on a .lock file before
  touching any cache files, serializing concurrent mutations to the
  same entry.

- TOCTOU-safe removal: remove() now calls remove_file() directly and
  treats NotFound as success, eliminating the race between checking
  existence and deleting.

Also moves revalidation.rs off raw fs::write() onto the new
CacheStore::write_content() method so all cache writes go through the
same safe path.
EOF
